name: ECOMATE
recent: Ecomate 于2025年8月25日召开特别股东大会，通过收购 Progressive Computer Systems 60% 股权、业务多元化至 ICT 解决方案，以及1送1红股和凭单发行等议案。2026年9月，公司获得价值 RM16.66 million 的软件订阅订单。最新季度（2026年8月31日止）营收同比增长96.5%，但净亏损扩大至 RM2.561 million。
notable: 获得价值 RM16.66 million 的软件订阅订单。
特别股东大会通过以 RM8.4 million 收购 Progressive Computer Systems 60% 股权。
特别股东大会通过1送1红股及凭单发行议案。
risks: 最新季度净亏损扩大至 RM2.561 million，净利率为 -14.4%。
红股及凭单发行可能带来股权摊薄。
earnings: 2026年8月31日止季度营收为 RM17.769 million，环比增长13.2%，同比增长96.5%；净亏损为 RM2.561 million，净利率 -14.4%，较上季度的 -7.4% 扩大。

recent_en: Ecomate held an EGM on 25 August 2025 where shareholders approved the acquisition of 60% of Progressive Computer Systems, diversification into ICT solutions, and a 1-for-1 bonus issue with warrants. In September 2026, the company secured a RM16.66 million software subscription order. For the latest quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue rose 96.5% year-on-year but net loss widened to RM2.561 million.
notable_en: Secured a RM16.66 million software subscription order.
EGM approved the acquisition of 60% of Progressive Computer Systems for RM8.4 million.
EGM approved a 1-for-1 bonus issue and warrants issuance.
risks_en: Net loss widened to RM2.561 million in the latest quarter, with a net margin of -14.4%.
The bonus issue and warrants issuance may lead to shareholding dilution.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM17.769 million, up 13.2% QoQ and 96.5% YoY; net loss was RM2.561 million with a net margin of -14.4%, wider than -7.4% in the previous quarter.
